summary.text: Dana Ferrell is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates for District 60, where he has served since 2020, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is a former teacher and the founder of RSN Sports Network.

paragraphs.text: Dana Ferrell was born in Charleston, West Virginia.
He earned an A.A.S. in business management and marketing and a B.S. in business education, both from West Virginia State University, and an M.A. in special education from Marshall University in 1999.
His professional experience includes working as a teacher and founding RSN Sports Network, where he also served as president.
Ferrell served on the Charleston Sports Committee from 2008 to 2011, as the St. Francis Hospital chairman of the board from 2016 to 2018, and on the Thomas Health System Board from 2009 to 2018.
He also founded and served as president of the Greater Sissonville Development Council.
Ferrell has served in the House of Delegates since 2020 and advanced from the Republican primary on May 12, 2026.
